messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTO-PAGE fired for eval-gate-output-drift-service (P1) -> PD#PD-83421
incident-bot: Trigger: eval-gate (safety + output-drift) threshold breached: safety=3.1% (alert>2.0%), output-drift=7.3% (alert>5%)
ryan_oncall: acked. I'm on it. starting quick triage. tagging @nate_sre for infra-level checks and @anika_ml for eval details
nate_sre: looking at routing and recent rollouts. I see a canary deploy 03:12 UTC that switched traffic to model v2q-8b-quant. pulling GPU logs now
anika_ml: pulling the eval run that tripped the gate. quick summary: metrics spiked on toxic-safety test set and semantic hallucination eval. attaching top failing prompts
maria_support: support-bot reported 9 distinct user sessions with degraded responses (customers: acme-inc, bright-shop, travelly). errors are incorrect/unsafe completions, non-HTTP errors (low quality), no 500s. informing CS and account owners now :phone
support-bot: Alert ingest: 9 customer complaints linked to session traces. sample trace id: trace-7c9f2a. Confidence match with eval failures 0.82
ryan_oncall: thanks. Nate, can we reroute traffic to fallback model (v2q-8b-legacy) and throttle canary? we need to reduce blast radius
nate_sre: initiating routing change: `rwctl route update eval-service --from v2q-8b-quant --to v2q-8b-legacy --weight 0.0`
nate_sre: routing change applied, canary traffic 0%, fallback model now receiving 100% for new inferences. latency unaffected. logs: `ok: 200` for routing command
anika_ml: re-running the eval gate against recent production requests sample (n=200). preliminary: safety regression now 1.9%, output-drift 1.2% — both below thresholds. looks like routing change stopped further degradation
ryan_oncall: good. please leave canary disabled and we'll hold. Nate, can you snapshot the canary we rolled (v2q-8b-quant) and attach kernel/quantization config for review
nate_sre: snapshot created: snapshot-6123456789. attaching kernel flags: `--int8-qkv true --kv-cache=optimized --chunk-size=512`. also collecting perf counters
jess_pm: rough customer impact note for postmortem: impacted sessions showed increased unsafe content score and incoherent completions; no outages or 5xxs; CS outreach in progress. we'll need a runbook update to include forced canary cut and auto-routing fallback step
maria_support: CS has opened tickets for the 9 accounts, pro-active outreach scheduled. escalation to enterprise success for Acme started :email:
support-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-83421 acknowledged by ryan_oncall at 6123456792; auto-escalation suppressed after ack
ateam: (system) timeline marker: canary rollback + routing change at 6123456805
anika_ml: saved failing prompt set to s3://redwood-evals/incident-6123456789/failing_prompts.json for root-cause investigation
ryan_oncall: preparing incident summary for triage. short checklist: 1) confirm no more degraded responses in sampling 2) preserve canary snapshot & logs 3) notify product/security if any safety leaks 4) schedule postmortem
ateam: (system) handoff note: oncall shift change in 55 minutes. ryan_oncall -> jess_pm for next steps
jess_pm: I'll take next shift. please DM me any urgent logs. creating incident thread in ops-incident-triage for postmortem prep
ryan_oncall: final check: are there any customers currently in-progress that need immediate rollback of data handling? Maria?
maria_support: no live churn reported, all affected sessions from window 03:10-03:18 UTC. CS will patch customers' session windows and provide mitigations. marking as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident PD-83421 transition: state=mitigated, notes="traffic rerouted to fallback model; canary snapshot saved; CS notified"
ryan_oncall: closing active page. leaving incident open for postmortem. thanks team.
jess_pm: acknowledged, will coordinate postmortem and timeline. tagging @anika_ml and @nate_sre for root cause investigation tasks
